_comment: Machine-readable campaign schedule, read by scripts/social-post.mjs.
It is a ROTATION, not a dated list: the campaign cannot run out of content
and die in week five. Each slot walks its rotation and wraps around.
To add a new poster: create the folder under marketing/{posts,status}/,
add the entry to src/lib/posters.ts, then append the slug here.
posting-schedule.md is the human calendar; this file is what actually runs.

feed._comment: Instagram feed + Facebook Page. Every 3 days, morning.

_comment: WhatsApp Status + Instagram Story. Daily except the rest day.
restDays uses JS day numbers: 0 = Sunday. The README's own rule is that
Sunday is a rest day, so the automation honours it.
